summary_claims.claim: Action policy 9.53: AI governance framework to classify AI systems by risk
Benchmarking, standardisation and certification of AI systems
Regulatory sandbox for safe development and testing
AI Regulation Council chaired by the ICT minister; Member Secretary is chief of the National AI Centre
Council meets at least twice a year; policy reviewed every two years

note: Targeted search for an amendment or new version: none found. The Nepali text's text layer is garbled, so I checked the sandbox clause against the English text and the garbled Nepali layer only roughly. Original title matches the Nepal Law Commission page. Whether to make the Nepali PDF the official_url is left to a person.
